In Table 3 of the paper (note-level F-measure ablation results, page 5), the in-note beat model's scores are:

- **Extra-note augmentation omitted:** precision 91.2, recall 94.3, F-score 91.3 (p. 5)
- **All augmentation methods used:** F-score 92.2, with precision 92.9 and recall 93.7 (p. 5)

So leaving out the extra-note augmentation lowers the F-score by 0.9 points. The authors conclude that all four augmentation methods help, and that tempo change helps most (p. 6).

The extra-note row has exactly the same numbers (91.2 / 94.3 / 91.3) as the "Use all features" row in the input-feature half of the same table (p. 5). That could be a coincidence or a copy error in the paper. The PDF text gives no way to tell which.
